A great game from a bygone era. I, like many, got this on 360 because it had the Gears 3 beta on it, but I'm equally as happy with the game itself. Total mayhem, absurd amounts of foul language for the sake of it, and a point system that does lend itself to making the player want to be better. You gain points by killing enemies in creative ways and looking to maximize output, Which you want to do because you need points for well....just about everything, and typical kills dont net much. That being said, you CAN get points from doing just about anything and will get a lot of special kills by accident in the madness. They range from getting a head or neck shot, to shooting a dude in the balls, then the head, to a variety of environmental kills, to just absurd things like shooting a guy with a homing drill and making the homing drill hit another dude in the butt.

The story is pure nonsense, so much so you can play as Duke Nukem and even with John St.John providing Duke lines for the replacement protagonist, it's pure pants on head ridiculous, with a number of Dukes lines being "I'm not even supposed to be here!"

Totally worth it on sale and the game  gives you plenty of ways to replay, which is basically a lost art now-a-days.

Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition — это яркий, безбашенный и крайне весёлый шутер, который в 2017 году получил заслуженное второе дыхание. Если вы любите динамичные FPS с акцентом на креативное убийство врагов, то это ваш билет в один из самых недооценённых экшенов прошлого поколения.03
Плюсы:
	•	Геймплей — просто огонь! Система Skillshot — это лучшее, что придумали для шутеров. Каждый выстрел, пинок, удар цепью или бросок врага в кактус/вентилятор/электричество приносит очки и адреналин. Игра буквально поощряет тебя быть максимально жестоким и изобретательным. Бои никогда не надоедают.
	•	Юмор и атмосфера. Пошлый, дерзкий, самоироничный сюжет с кучей матов и отсылок. Главный герой Грейсон Хант — классический космонавт-алкаш с большим ртом. Если вы фанат Duke Nukem (которого здесь можно играть за отдельные деньги или предзаказ), то будете в своей тарелке.
	•	Ремастер удался. Unreal Engine 4, 60 FPS, улучшенные текстуры, освещение и эффекты. Игра выглядит свежо даже сейчас, особенно на высоких настройках. Все DLC включены из коробки + новые Echo-карты и Overkill-режим (где сразу дают все пушки).18
	•	Реплейбилити. Кампания на 6–8 часов пролетает на одном дыхании, но хочется перепроходить ради высоких очков, новых skillshot’ов и Echo-режима.
Минусы:
	•	Цена на релизе была завышена для «просто ремастера». Сейчас на Steam часто бывают скидки — вот тогда и берите.
	•	Мультиплеер живёт своей жизнью, но он никогда не был главной фишкой игры.
	•	Иногда заметны мелкие баги (texture pop-in), хотя в целом стабильность хорошая.2
Вердикт: Если вы пропустили оригинал 2011 года — настоятельно рекомендую. Это один из самых весёлых и креативных шутеров за последние 15 лет. Чистый кайф от перестрелки, где каждый бой превращается в кровавый цирк.
Оценка: 85/100 (Very Positive) Играю уже не первый раз и всё равно улыбаюсь как идиот, когда отправляю очередного мутанта в полёт через карту. Берите на распродаже и наслаждайтесь безумием! 🚀💥

[h3]LLUVIA DE BALAS: EDICIÓN CARGADOR LLENO[/h3]

No puedo creer que este juego pase tan desapercibido, es buenísimo. Frenético, rápido, creativo y muy divertido, la formula de combate basada en disparos y patadas es magnífica. Me encantó y lo recomiendo mucho. Voy a resumir lo que me pareció excelente y lo que no me gustó del juego: 

[b]PUNTOS POSITIVOS [/b]
✅La historia, que es aceptable en cuanto a calidad y corta en duración. 
✅Los diálogos entre los personajes, son muy graciosos. 
✅Las armas y sus habilidades, junto con el adictivo sistema de cuerpo a cuerpo y daño ambiental (me encantó).
✅Los escenarios muy detallados, variados e interesantes. 
✅La cantidad aceptable de logros divertidos de hacer. 
✅La banda sonora.

[b]PUNTOS NEGATIVOS [/b]
❌El final abierto. Parece que la intención era hacer una secuela, pero eso pudo haberse hecho dejando vivo al personaje principal solamente. El final que tiene el juego, como bien dijo otra de las reseñas, hace que toda la aventura carezca de sentido. 

[h3]CONCLUSIÓN[/h3]
Recomiendo totalmente este juego, me encantó y, salvo el final, todo es excelente. Realmente no había visto nada antes de jugarlo y al probarlo me llevé una sorpresa muy agradable. Si tuviese que describirlo brevemente sería que es el juego en el que pienso cuando me dicen "juego de disparos". Las secciones de estilo "juego arcade de centro comercial" y otras sorpresas (como cierto mapa de referencia a un reptil muy conocido y de gran tamaño extremadamente conocido y querido en Japón) hacen que me asombre de solo recordarlo. Probablemente vuelva a pasármelo en algún momento, así que, de nuevo, súper recomendado👍

I played this one back when it came out on the Xbox 360. It's fun to come back to it after all these years.

Before I talk about the main game, I just want to address the Duke Nukem addon - It is absolutely fantastic, provided you are familiar with Duke's personality and/or you have played through the story of Bulletstorm already. If you are playing for the first time, I would highly recommend playing as the original protagonist, Grayson Hunt. That being said, if you love the Duke and you don't really care about the story feeling weirdly off, have at it!

Bulletstorm is very much a game from its era - the linear storyline, the level design, the humour, heck even the absolutely useless companion AI programming. The story is alright, but it is merely a vehicle for the action. The unique draw of Bulletsorm however is the leash and kick mechanics that allow you to throw around almost all enemy types like ragdolls. There is a ton of fun to be had simply hurling enemies into all sorts of spikes, explosives, bottomless pits and the such.

The problem lies in the fact that there isn't too much depth past that really. The game is short, so it doesn't feel like a drag, but if you are expecting depth in abilities or enemy types, you will be disappointed.

The pros still outweigh the cons in my mind, so if you want a no-nonsense, simple romp around, go right aheand and pick up Bulletstorm.

And if you do pick up the Duke edition - Hail to the King, baby!!!

Bulletstorm knows exactly what it is and has absolutely zero interest in being anything else, which is honestly refreshing.

People Can Fly built a shooter where the entire point is killing people creatively and then giving you points for doing it with style. Kick someone into a cactus, points. Feed someone into a giant rotating drill, points. Launch an enemy into the air and shoot them into another enemy, more points. The skillshot system is stupid and brilliant in equal measure and the game wears both of those things like a badge of honor.

The writing is aggressively juvenile in a way that clearly made everyone involved laugh during production and that energy is contagious. It is not trying to say anything. It is not building toward a meaningful emotional moment. It is trying to make you feel like the coolest idiot in the room for the four or five hours it takes to finish it and it succeeds at that specific goal completely.

Linear shooters that don't overstay their welcome have become genuinely rare and Bulletstorm is a good reminder of why that's a loss. Get in, cause maximum chaos, get out, feel good about it. No live service, no open world padding, no morality system asking you to reflect on your choices. Just guns and electricity whips and a leash that lets you drag enemies toward your boot.

Worth noting People Can Fly went on to work on Outriders and Gears of War Judgment after this, but Bulletstorm remains the most purely themselves they've ever been on a project. Easy recommendation for anyone who just wants to shoot things in increasingly creative ways without being asked to care too much.

[h2]Uno sparatutto fuori dagli schemi: la gemma irriverente che meritava più successo[/h2] 

Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition è uno di quegli sparatutto che riescono davvero a distinguersi dalla massa, grazie a un’idea di gameplay tanto semplice quanto geniale. Il cuore dell’esperienza non è solo sparare, ma farlo con stile: il sistema dei “tiri d’abilità” trasforma ogni scontro in una sorta di spettacolo creativo, premiando il giocatore per inventiva e audacia.

Avevo già giocato alla versione base su Xbox 360, e tornare su questa edizione è stato come riscoprire una piccola gemma. È proprio uno di quei titoli che, col senno di poi, meritava decisamente più successo di quanto abbia ottenuto: originale, divertente e con una personalità fortissima.

Ogni nemico diventa un’opportunità per sperimentare: calci, frustate energetiche e armi esagerate si combinano in modi sempre nuovi, rendendo ogni combattimento dinamico e mai ripetitivo. Questo approccio rompe la monotonia tipica di molti FPS tradizionali, offrendo un ritmo più frenetico e appagante.

La Full Clip Edition migliora ulteriormente l’esperienza con una grafica aggiornata e contenuti aggiuntivi, rendendo il titolo ancora più godibile anche oggi. Inoltre, il linguaggio volutamente scurrile e totalmente politicamente scorretto contribuisce a dargli un’identità ben precisa, quasi nostalgica: un gioco che sembra arrivare da un’epoca diversa, meno filtrata e più sopra le righe.

In definitiva, Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition è perfetto per chi cerca uno sparatutto fuori dagli schemi, capace di premiare creatività e spettacolarità invece della semplice precisione.

I played this game as a kid and LOVED it.  I remember thinking the game was really funny, the combat loop was really impressive and addictive, and it had some really fun set pieces.  And hey, you know, I was right about at least one thing: the game's combat is REALLY damn good.

This game is a product of its time.  Back when just saying funny swears was enough to be impactful and funny, and when having alcohol called Nom Juice would win you the internetz.  So much of the humor fell flat now that I'm older.  This game LOVES combining swears with other words.  There were a few points in this game where I was like, "Oh yeah, I LOVED that line", while kinda cringing at it now.  But hey, ya know, I was a kid then.  

As for the set pieces, with the exception of the monster theme park from the beginning of the game, I just don't think the majority of this game's levels are all too memorable.  They all sort of blend together.  At least the level design lent itself well to the combat, which is AWESOME.  

The skillshots were SO cool.  I think if they made a new game with this mechanic, it'd be crazy successful.  Honestly, I was reminded of my time with Doom Eternal quite a bit while trying for different skillshots.  It was really fun!  Leashing and kicking were awesome aspects of the game too  There were a bunch of times where the game just lets you get away with standing behind a spiked wall and mashing Q to leash people one by one, racking up a bunch of currency.  It's so damned satisfying.

I do think this port could have been a bit better.  My first few times trying to launch the game led in it crashing a bunch.  Once I got that figured out it was mostly fine, though there were many times (in the second half of the game especially) where I'd be running, and just stop due to hitting something in the environment I should have been able to run over.  If it happened a handful of times, then whatever.  But this happened a TON.  It led to a small number of deaths too, which was obnoxious.

But I did still have fun.  The gameplay's awesome, but everything else wrapped around it wasn't as good as I remembered.
